summary.intent: Run a marathon overnight autonomous session (10:35 PM to 8 AM) to improve Cohezion's EVO (Exotic Vacuum Object) agent modeling pipeline, fix all test failures across the codebase, and build compound engineering tooling using teams of specialist agents with TDD, V-model systems engineering, and multi-perspective adversarial review.
summary.outcome: Built a complete EVO modeling closed-loop pipeline (E1-E62 experiments validated, E55-E62 fixing the original E5 Mycelium compounding bug), created 10+ new compound analytics modules, fixed ~300+ tests across FLUME/compound/core/arc/universe suites, and committed the E57 additive calibration fix that caused the original Mycelium feedback to decay instead of compound.

repo: autoresearch.jsonl stores experiment label at r['asi']['experiment'], not r['experiment']; status at r['status'] not r['verdict']; primary metric at r['metric'] not r['delta']

QuadratureNexus two-layer calibration model: _mycelium_calibration (cross-cycle, accumulates) vs _score_adjustments (per-deliberation, overwritten by run_llm_deliberation every call). Always target _mycelium_calibration for persistent feedback
The Mycelium compounding formula is consensus_n = 0.85 - 0.125 * (1 - lr/2)^n; lr=2.0 lifts a 0.725-baseline nexus to exactly 0.85 in one synthesis cycle
Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically resets working tree to HEAD; use 'git checkout HEAD -- <file>' or 'git stash push --keep-index' to recover staged changes
autoresearch.jsonl is tracked by LFS but has real JSON content in working tree, causing pointer/content conflicts in pre-commit stash/restore; fix: git rm --cached autoresearch.jsonl + .gitignore
FlumeVAE.forward() returns (recon, mu, log_var, z) - 4 values after the signature unification; legacy mode FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256) creates MLP VAE for backward compat
OllamaEmbeddingProvider was removed from cohezion.flume.vae_encoder; any test patching it fails at fixture setup (ERROR not FAILURE); fix by removing patch and using fallback_to_hash=True

SurrealDB: probe requires 'RETURN true;' not 'SELECT 1;'; datetime fields require time::now() not string literals; SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields - use result (option<string>) for variable data
BioelectricNetwork method is percolation_analysis(threshold=...) not percolate(); result field is largest_cluster_size not giant_component_fraction
psutil mock in compound conftest must mock BOTH virtual_memory AND cpu_percent=25.0 or resource guardrails fail on busy machines (99.4% CPU = guardrail triggers = test failures)

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback() uses += into _mycelium_calibration (E57 fix); previously used SET semantics causing Cycle 2 to decay. History cap at 5 entries; _detect_oscillation() halves lr when last 3 adjustments alternate sign

Dual-mode FlumeVAE: token-based transformer (production, FlumeVAEConfig) + legacy MLP (input_dim/latent_dim args). forward() returns (recon, mu, log_var, z) always 4 values. reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode. flume_vae_loss() is a standalone module-level function

check_precipitation() added to AxiomaticState combining HIHO threshold (coherence > 0.5), Shannon entropy, and thermodynamic free energy F = E - TS. Returns Python bool explicitly (np.bool_ causes type failures)
SessionMetricsAggregator tracks HIHO balance (fraction of positive-delta experiments). render_dashboard() returns dict with ascii_bar, top_experiments, mode (exploit/explore), retirement_candidates
Autouse psutil fixture must mock BOTH virtual_memory (percent=50.0, total=128GiB) AND cpu_percent=25.0. Mocking only memory is insufficient - cpu guardrail in executor.py triggers separately
WarmCacheLoader.load_cache() proxy method needed - tests expect it but class only had warm_client(). Added as thin delegation to self._persistence.load_cache()

log_result() signature: log_result(run, metric, metrics, status, description, experiment, **extra) - 6 positional args. run = int(time.time()*1000), status = 'keep' or 'discard'. E71-E76 initially had wrong 4-arg calls

New module: compute_experiment_stats(), find_retirement_candidates() (CV < 0.05 after 10+ keeps), compute_hiho_balance(), compute_schedule_diversity() (Shannon entropy). Live data shows E50/E12 have CV=0.000 (retirement candidates)

workflow: Surgical git add pattern: 'uv run ruff format <files>' then 'uv run ruff check --select=F,E9,E501 --fix <files>' then 'git add <specific files only>' then 'KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 git commit'. Never use 'git add -A' in this repo
Pre-commit stash/restore conflicts with LFS files: use 'git stash push --keep-index --include-untracked' before staging, then 'git stash pop' after commit
When adding async methods to a class that has synchronous callers, always add a _sync wrapper immediately and update all existing sync call sites atomically in the same commit
For unittest.TestCase async tests: patch httpx.AsyncClient (not httpx.Client), use AsyncMock for post/aclose methods, wrap all async calls in asyncio.run()
FastMCP content format requires {"type": "text", "text": "..."} - missing 'type' field causes silent fallthrough to wrong return branch
V-model structural invariant tests using inspect.signature() run ~1ms each and catch refactor drift (renamed params, removed fields) before behavioral tests
TDD cycle for removed symbols: tests fail at import/fixture time (ERROR not FAILURE) when patching removed classes - fix by removing patches and using the built-in fallback mode

KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 required for every commit due to branch guard on competition-related files
